user_query: I'm planning to organize a gaming event for my company's employees. Can you recommend some popular games and provide me with the statistics related to the 'Paladin' class from Hearthstone? Also, fetch the details of the top players and influencers in the Diablo 4 community.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of popular games suitable for a corporate gaming event.
Fetch statistics related to the 'Paladin' class from Hearthstone.
Collect details of the top players in the Diablo 4 community.
Obtain information about the key influencers in the Diablo 4 community.
